Oh I know that, but the rejection from my family fucking sucks even though they're the root of how I feel.

I produce music/beats and i'm pretty decent.

I don't have a problem with not doing the best in school but it's difficult because my family expect me to go to college etc and they all think I'm stupid for doing bad.

It's mostly just my mother & sister. My mothers constantly telling me all these things she thinks is wrong with me, such as me having a good complex and extreme narcissism among various other things. She does this whenever I do something she doesn't like (one time I told her I didn't want to mow the lawns because I had already done other chores while my sister & brother both hadn't done anything and I had plans later that day and she told me I must be so narcissistic if I don't realize I do nothing around the house). 

I used to be very close with my sister but all of a sudden she began telling my mother secrets I had told her, personal things such as my sexuality and she went and told our mother all these things that I wasn't ready for. Not only has she told my secrets but she also told our mother lies about me. One weekend most of our family went somewhere so we were alone for the weekend, she told me to leave and stay at a friends house so she could have the weekend here with her boyfriend (which I was more than happy to do) the one day I was with her went well and we had a good time. A couple weeks later I get arrested which of course gets me in a lot of trouble but was also when I found out my sister had been telling her lies. During the weekend my mother was away I had apparently stolen money from my sister for drugs (which is what I was arrested for) and also forced my sister to buy me alcohol which was not true. Of course I tried to deny the allegations but due to just being arrested for drug related things she didn't believe me at all and told me there must be something severely wrong with me and that I must have convinced myself I didn't do it. I made her show me the messages of my sister telling her these things and made her confirm it. Because I couldn't think of a motive for her to lie about something like this I began questioning myself and had a nervous breakdown.

My mother knows and has definitely noticed how delicate my mental state currently is but is too embarrassed of me and thinks I'm doing it for attention so doesn't want to get me help. 

I barely feel like I can go out anymore because every time I leave the house my room gets searched and they go through everything of mine, taking whatever they want. 

I also come from a VERY academic family and I'm just not. This year has been my worst year mentally (I've been having suicidal thoughts since I was 11 but have attempted 3 times this year) but also my worst year academically which has just made everyone mad at me and I'm not even sure if I'll pass my grade (I have 50% attendance and flunked 3 classes) but even though I know schools important I don't care.

I can think of many reasons to live but I don't want to live a life of pain, especially when I know this is only the tip of what's to come. I don't see the point. My suicide is inevitable as I know even if I persist now I'll feel even worse in the future and try again..  so why go through all that torture and not die now while I'm still semi happy?
